tier1.notes: Adds a way to feed traffic to a third-party EFB when your tablet and your receiver are both joined to the same WiFi network -- a setup where some EFBs previously saw nothing at all. Nothing else changes, and connecting your tablet directly to the receiver's own WiFi network works exactly as before. Installs from the app in a few seconds; no card removal.

tier2.notes: Reflash required only if your receiver is older than 0.24.40 -- newer units can take this over the air from the app. Download the .img.xz to a computer and write it to the microSD card with BalenaEtcher -- not Raspberry Pi Imager, whose WiFi/hostname presets conflict with the receiver. Do not decompress the file first.
